info.title: Dataverse Catalog Tree
info.description: Dual-purpose Dataverse connector for recursive 1:N catalog hierarchies. Exposes an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio agents plus typed operations for Power Automate and Power Apps. The whole subtree is assembled server-side in a single call, so an agent never has to chain queries or invent relationship names.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio integration. Exposes catalog traversal tools over JSON-RPC 2.0.

get.description: Returns the real hierarchy shape for a table, read from Dataverse metadata: the self-referencing parent lookup if one exists, and every child relationship that can form the next level. Call this once to obtain an exact levels path instead of guessing relationship names.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Root table logical name or entity set name (for example account or accounts).

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Optional levels path to validate, for example tst_category_subcategories>tst_subcategory_products.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

get.description: Returns a whole subtree in one call. Traversal, depth limiting, cycle detection and child counting all happen server-side, so the caller receives a finished tree rather than a query to continue.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Root table logical name or entity set name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Root record GUID. Omit to start from every top-level record.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Ordered relationship path, separated by > . Omit for a self-referencing table, which repeats its own parent lookup at every level.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels below the root to expand (1-10). Default 3.

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: Node budget for the whole response (1-5000). Default 500. When the budget is hit the response is marked truncated rather than silently cut.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Extra comma-separated columns to return on every node.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: OData filter applied to child records at every level.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response shape. tree returns nested children, flat returns one row per node with its path, outline returns indented text, all returns every shape.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Traversal engine. auto picks the cheapest correct one: a single FetchXML hierarchy query when the table has a hierarchical parent lookup, otherwise a batched level walk.

parameters.name: includeChildCounts
parameters.description: Count children of the deepest returned nodes so the caller can report how much was left unexpanded. Default true.

parameters.name: rootTop
parameters.description: Maximum root records to return when no root record ID is supplied (1-500). Default 50. Exceeding it sets truncationReason to rootLimit.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

get.description: Returns one level of children for a node. Use this to drill into a branch that Get catalog tree reported as truncated.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table of the parent record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Parent record GUID.

parameters.name: relationship
parameters.description: Child relationship schema name. Omit for a self-referencing table.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Extra comma-separated columns to return.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: OData filter applied to the child records.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum children to return (1-1000). Default 100.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

get.description: Returns the breadcrumb from a node up to its root, so a caller can state where a record sits without reconstructing the path itself.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Table of the record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Record GUID.

parameters.name: rootTable
parameters.description: Root table of the catalog when levels are heterogeneous.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Ordered relationship path from the root table, separated by > .

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

get.description: Finds nodes by name across every level of the catalog and returns each match with its full path and ID. Use this to resolve a name the user typed into a real record before traversing.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Root table logical name or entity set name.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to match against the primary name column of each level.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Ordered relationship path, separated by > . Omit for a self-referencing table.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many levels below the root to search (1-10). Default 5.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum matches to return (1-100). Default 20.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

post.description: Creates a record and attaches it to a parent node in one call, resolving the correct lookup from relationship metadata.

table.description: Table to create the record in.

name.description: Value for the primary name column.

parentTable.description: Table of the parent record. Defaults to the same table for a self-referencing catalog.

parentId.description: Parent record GUID. Omit to create a root node.

relationship.description: Relationship schema name linking parent to child. Resolved automatically when unambiguous.

values.description: Additional column values to set on the new record.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

post.description: Reparents a node. The move is rejected if the new parent sits below the node, which would create a cycle.

table.description: Table of the record being moved.

id.description: GUID of the record being moved.

newParentId.description: GUID of the new parent. Omit to detach the node and make it a root.

parentTable.description: Table of the new parent. Defaults to the same table for a self-referencing catalog.

relationship.description: Relationship schema name linking parent to child. Resolved automatically when unambiguous.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

post.description: Rename a node or set other columns on it. Parent lookups are rejected here; use Move catalog node, which carries the cycle guard.

name.description: New value for the primary name column.

values.description: Other column values to set on the record.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

post.description: Delete a node. Refuses by default when the node has children and reports how many, so nothing is destroyed on a guess. A run that cannot finish within the call budget is refused outright rather than half-deleting a subtree.

onChildren.description: How to handle children: refuse stops when children exist, reparent attaches them to the node's parent, cascade deletes the whole subtree. reparent and cascade require a self-referencing catalog.

relationship.description: Child relationship schema name. Omit for a self-referencing table.

maxNodes.description: Ceiling on how many descendants a cascade may delete.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

get.description: Lists tables in the environment. Used to populate table pickers.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional text to match against the table name.

parameters.name: customOnly
parameters.description: Return only custom tables. Default true.

entitySetName.description: Entity set name used in Web API URLs.

get.description: Lists the one-to-many relationships that can form the next level below a table.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Parent table logical name or entity set name.

parameters.name: customOnly
parameters.description: Return only relationships to custom tables plus self-references. Default true.

400.description: Validation error with the list of valid values

CatalogError.description: Structured error that names the valid values, so a caller can correct itself instead of guessing.

providedValue.description: The value that could not be resolved.

schemaName.description: Relationship schema name, used in the levels path.

childTable.description: Logical name of the table on the many side.

childEntitySet.description: Entity set name of the child table.

lookupAttribute.description: Lookup column on the child that points at the parent.

navigationProperty.description: Collection-valued navigation property from parent to children.

isSelfReference.description: True when parent and child are the same table.

isHierarchical.description: True when the relationship is marked hierarchical, which enables single-query subtree retrieval.

totalCount.description: Total relationships found before any cap.

entitySet.description: Entity set name at this level.

relationship.description: Relationship schema name that produced this level.

lookupAttribute.description: Lookup column on the child that points at the parent.

labelAttribute.description: Primary name column used as the node label.
Primary name column of the root table.

mode.description: selfReference when one table points at itself, levels when each depth is a different table.

repeating.description: True when the same relationship repeats at every depth.

hierarchical.description: True when the parent lookup is marked hierarchical in Dataverse.

recommendedStrategy.description: Traversal engine that auto would choose.

levelsPath.description: Exact levels value to pass to the other operations.

candidateRelationships.description: Relationships that could extend the path by one level.

notes.description: Warnings about the shape of this catalog.

id.description: Record GUID. Pass this back verbatim in later calls.

table.description: Table logical name of this node.

entitySet.description: Entity set name of this node.

parentId.description: GUID of the parent node, empty at the root.

path.description: Slash-separated labels from the root to this node.

childCount.description: Children known to exist. Present even when they were not expanded.

hasMoreChildren.description: True when children exist that are not included in this response.

fields.description: Extra columns requested through the fields parameter.

hasMoreChildren.description: True when children were not all returned.

truncated.description: True when the tree is incomplete.

truncationReason.description: Why the tree is incomplete: depthLimit, nodeBudget, pageLimit or requestBudget.

cyclesDetected.description: Records skipped because they had already been visited.

dataverseRequests.description: Web API calls made to build this response.

roots.description: Root nodes with their expanded children.

flat.description: One row per node, returned when format is flat or all.

outline.description: Indented text rendering of the tree, returned when format is outline or all.

deleted.description: True when the node was removed.

onChildren.description: Child handling mode that was applied.

childrenReparented.description: Children attached to the deleted node's parent.

hasMore.description: True when more records exist beyond the ones returned.

path.description: Slash-separated labels from the root down to the node.

depth.description: Distance of the node below its root.

ancestors.description: Ancestors ordered from the root down to the immediate parent.
